title: Case: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link
context: A notification points to a malformed path. Support must provide the correct shipment reference without asking the customer to follow an unknown link.
initial_request: The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.

events.body: Route plan for depot HL-8 published for Tuesday. 20 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
DL-8707 notification path was truncated by our template. The account-linked notification belongs to this recipient; the shipment reference itself is intact in our order record.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Friday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask carrier support to provide the correct tracking reference through the verified customer channel.

must_not: Tracking access is not delivery. No live URL or credentials are provided.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please send Ulric the correct DL-8707 tracking reference and portal navigation through the verified order thread. Do not send a payment request or ask for credentials.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-017: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
